concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-risk-management-fraud-data-collection]] — Adyen Web fraud-data collection guide (webpage snapshot, 2026-09-15) distinguishing automatic checkout collection from API-only SDK handoff, Protect-independent defaults, privacy duties, and collected-data categories.
warnings: Risk data collection is on by default for stated Web checkout routes independently of Protect configuration; disabling Protect does not itself establish collection is off.
Adyen's privacy discussion is region-conditional merchant guidance, not independent current legal authority; API-only raw-card processing has separate PCI requirements.
